description_full: Messier 42 is a diffuse nebula in the Milky Way situated south of Orion's Belt in the constellation of Orion, and is known as the middle 'star' in the 'sword' of Orion. It is 1,267.0 ± 5.4 light-years (388.5 ± 1.7 pc) away.  M42 is estimated to be 25 light-years across (so its apparent size from Earth is approximately 1 degree)
